pages.text: Pweza Bond Fund factsheet, issued by Anga Asset Managers (SYN). Pweza Bond Fund is a bond fund and its objective is to generate regular income from government and corporate bonds. The management fee of Pweza Bond Fund is 1.6 percent per annum. The minimum initial investment in Pweza Bond Fund is SYN Sh 5,000, and the minimum top-up is SYN Sh 1,000. Over the 12 months to 2026-09-30 Pweza Bond Fund delivered an effective annual yield of 9.7 percent.

Withdrawals from Pweza Bond Fund are paid within 1 business days. The main holdings of Pweza Bond Fund are infrastructure bonds (55 percent), Treasury bonds (45 percent) and corporate bonds (25 percent). Bara Custodial (SYN) acts as trustee of Pweza Bond Fund and holds its assets separately from the manager. Pweza Bond Fund was launched in 2012 and is licensed by the SYN Capital Markets Authority. Past performance is not a guarantee of future results and the value of units can fall. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
